subject.title: WhatsApp: Gemini thinking tags (<think>/<final>) still leak after #6328 fix

question: Should strict delivery sanitization suppress unclosed reasoning by extracting only the `<final>` body when present, or keep the current fallback that returns all text after an unclosed `<think>` to avoid empty replies?
rationale: The current behavior is intentionally tested for malformed-output recovery, but the same recovery can expose hidden reasoning in user-visible channels, so automation should not choose the security/product tradeoff alone.

options.title: Change shared strict fallback
options.body: Extract the final body when available and otherwise fail closed on unclosed reasoning, then add shared and channel regression proof.

options.title: Keep recovery fallback
options.body: Accept possible reasoning exposure to preserve malformed-answer recovery, and close this as an intentional security tradeoff with clear documentation.

options.title: Patch channels individually
options.body: Add WhatsApp/Telegram/WebChat-specific coordinators while leaving the shared fallback semantics unchanged, accepting duplicate parser behavior.

recommendation.title: Change shared strict fallback
recommendation.body: Extract the final body when available and otherwise fail closed on unclosed reasoning, then add shared and channel regression proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The most relevant current blame and shared sanitizer ownership signal points to steipete, with the caveat that local history is shallow.
